initialExam.title: IBBI Grade A Officer 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Officers in Grade A at the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) for regulation, supervision, and development of insolvency professionals, agencies, and information utilities.
initialExam.syllabus: Phase I: English Language (Reading Comprehension, Grammar, Vocabulary, Cloze Test), General Awareness (Financial Awareness, Banking, Insurance, Capital Markets, Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, Current Affairs), Quantitative Aptitude (Number System, Percentage, Ratio, SI/CI, Data Interpretation, Probability), Reasoning Ability (Puzzles, Seating Arrangement, Syllogism, Inequality, Coding-Decoding). Phase II: Professional Knowledge (IBC 2016, Corporate Law, Finance & Accounting, Economics), Descriptive English.
initialExam.examPattern: Phase I (Prelims): English + GA + Quant + Reasoning - 200 marks, 120 minutes. Phase II (Mains): Professional Knowledge + Descriptive English - 200 marks, 180 minutes. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Phase I - Online Exam (Prelims) → Phase II - Online Exam (Mains) → Interview → Document Verification → Final Merit

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Performance-linked incentive, Pension (NPS), Residential quarters, Car facility at senior levels
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade A → Grade B → Grade C → Grade D → Executive Director → Whole Time Member → Chairperson.
initialExam.jobRole: Regulation and supervision of insolvency resolution, liquidation and bankruptcy processes. Policy formulation, research, and enforcement of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ibbi.gov.in 2. Go to Careers section 3. Register 4. Fill application form 5. Upload documents 6. Pay fee online 7. Submit

previousYearPapers.paper: Phase I: English + GA + Quant + Reasoning
